Metadata.title: Get iT — If you want it, you can get it
Metadata.description: The personal growth platform that turns your goals into plans, daily actions and measurable progress: physical, mental, social and financial.

Common.slogan: If you want it, you can get it.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.subtitle: Get iT AI needs your permission to use your data.
consent.data: To help you, Get iT AI receives your messages and a summary of your data: your first name, pillars, goals and milestones, tasks, habits and streaks, level, scores and check-ins from the last 7 days.
consent.processor: This data is processed by Anthropic, which provides the Claude AI model, on servers located outside Québec. Under its terms, Anthropic doesn’t use it to train its models.
consent.control: You can withdraw your permission and delete your conversations at any time in Settings.
consent.disclaimer: Get iT AI provides educational information: it doesn’t replace a doctor, a psychologist or a financial advisor.

join.title: Join the Get iT Hub
join.subtitle: Share your progress, ask your questions and cheer others on.
join.usernameHelp: 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers or “_”. Your first name, username and level will be visible to members. Your goals, habits and check-ins stay private.

rules.respect: Be respectful: no insults, harassment or hate speech.
rules.progress: Share real things: your progress, questions and tips. No ads or spam.
rules.safety: Health or money tips don’t replace a professional. If you’re in distress, call or text 9-8-8.
rules.privacy: Don’t post personal information, yours or anyone else’s.
rules.honesty: Report anything that breaks these rules: moderation will handle it.
